pages.title: Intimidation
pages.text: Press Alt+L to use Intimidation and briefly halt nearby mobs. You can rebind the key in Controls. A successful cast enters cooldown even if nothing is nearby.

pages.title: Tiers and Maids
pages.text: Cumulative maid kills raise your Intimidation tier. Tier I is available without any kills. Your maids become more fearful when affected, and their current daily events may end. A Doting Maid behaves for a while afterward.

pages.title: Tiers I–III
pages.text: Each line shows cumulative maid kills / radius / duration / cooldown.$(br2)$(li)Tier I: 0 / 16 blocks / 8 sec / 15 min$(li)Tier II: 1 / 24 blocks / 10 sec / 12 min$(li)Tier III: 10 / 32 blocks / 12 sec / 8 min

pages.title: Tiers IV–V
pages.text: Order: cumulative maid kills / radius / duration / cooldown.$(br2)$(li)Tier IV: 100 / 48 blocks / 15 sec / 3 min$(li)Tier V: 1000 / 64 blocks / 20 sec / 1 min
